You are responsible for leading the entire sales cycle; researching, prospecting, advising, negotiating contracts, and closing deals across companies with 10 to 1,000 employees. You are accountable for developing account plans using the MEDDPICC sales methodology to build new business and achieve your territory goals. You are able to identify and deeply understand a prospect's needs, pains, and desired business outcomes to build an effective business case that demonstrates ROI and the value proposition of the Outreach platform. Your primary points of contact at prospective new customers are above-the-line contacts (CRO, COO, CEO, CFO, and CISO). Key performance indicators include quota attainment, pipeline generation and coverage, and forecast quality and accuracy.

lists.content:
This role sits at the intersection of Product, GTM, and Customers. The Director of Product Strategy is the product expert who bridges what we build with how we sell, enable, and position it in market.

You will work across the Outreach platform to deeply understand the product direction and roadmap, then evangelize it across GTM teams and customers. You will evaluate the market, competition and partners, identify what the next opportunities to expand TAM and inform product strategy to capture that TAM.

Shaping Strategy:
  • Work closely with CPO and product line leaders, translating market reality into actionable product context and accelerating the evolution into an end-to-end agentic revenue platform.
  • Track the market and competitive landscape and customer feedback, translating that into Outreach positioning and roadmap priorities
  • Work with technology partners to inform partner strategies to expand offerings - co-sell, resell or OEM.
  • Guide pricing and packaging decisions, with evolving pricing models for AI-native products
    • Evangelizing the Product:
  • Own QBR content and field-facing product updates — presenting with depth and conviction
  • Serve as the trusted product expert in customer conversations and strategic sales cycles
  • Build and maintain crisp, business-oriented product collateral: positioning decks, competitive battlecards, release narratives, and roadmap presentations
  • Support analyst relations, investor materials, and board-level content across the platform
  • Present roadmap and demo new capabilities at marquee events - including Customer Advisory Boards and industry conferences
    • Enabling GTM:
  • Partner with Sales Enablement and Product Marketing to ensure releases land compellingly across the field
  • Work with PS/CS teams to get feedback from pilot customers to inform product roadmap, and drive AI consumption across the platform

• 8+ years in strategy consulting, product management or sales strategy in B2B SaaS
  • Ability and desire to dig into new technologies and develop disruptive strategies.
  • Market research, qualitative and quantitative, experience leading projects.
  • Proven track record presenting product overviews and strategy to executive audiences — QBRs, EBCs, SKOs, or equivalent
  • Experience with AI tools for Sales or GTM; knowledge of Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, or Gong is a strong plus
  • Exceptional communicator — able to make a complex roadmap land clearly with Sales leaders; low-ego and disciplined collaborator across a distributed team

• Background in sales enablement, pre-sales, or revenue operations alongside product experience
  • Prior experience at a company navigating a platform transition
  • MBA a plus

lists.content:
• Acting as a strategic advisor to executive stakeholders (CROs, COOs, CTOs, VPs of RevOps, etc.), influencing vision and technical direction for enterprise customers. 
  • Owning the technical strategy for high-value, multi-threaded deals, driving discovery, solution design, and value articulation aligned to customer initiatives. 
  • Leading engaging, outcome-based demonstrations and Proof of Value (POV) engagements that connect Outreach’s capabilities to business outcomes. 
  • Partnering with AEs to craft win strategies using MEDDPICC, Demo2Win, and value-selling frameworks. 
  • Translating complex business processes into scalable, ROI-driven solutions and clearly articulating “the art of the possible” through Outreach’s platform and AI agents (Amplify, Kaia, Research Agent). 
  • Building credibility as a subject matter expert in revenue execution, pipeline management, and AI innovation. 
  • Acting as a mentor and deal coach to Solutions Consultants, providing feedback and guidance on demo execution, discovery, and strategic selling. 
  • Collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Enablement to influence roadmap priorities and build differentiated enterprise narratives. 
  • Creating and maintaining scalable demo and POV assets, vertical playbooks, and industry-specific solution stories. 
  • Representing Outreach as a thought leader through webinars, customer roundtables, and industry events.

• Experience: 7+ years of pre-sales or solution consulting experience, with 3+ years in SaaS enterprise environments focused on CRM, sales execution, or revenue orchestration technologies. 
  • Enterprise Mastery: Proven success leading multi-stakeholder sales cycles, designing integrations such as: Salesforce, Seismic, ZoomInfo, Snowflake, etc., and influencing C-suite alignment. 
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Ability to diagnose complex customer environments and translate them into clear, measurable solutions. 
  • Exceptional Communication: Comfortable facilitating executive conversations, leading whiteboard sessions, and delivering compelling demos tailored to diverse personas. 
  • Technical & AI Acumen: Combines strong technical and commercial acumen, with expertise in data architecture, automation, and AI applications that drive measurable improvements in sales productivity and revenue growth. 
  • Leadership Without Title: You mentor others, provide constructive deal coaching, and serve as an informal leader who elevates team standards. 
  • Enablement Contribution: Experience creating internal assets, playbooks, or demo stories that others adopt and scale across the org. 
  • Continuous Learning: Actively seek new methods, tools, and frameworks that drive better outcomes for customers and peers. 
  • Training & Certifications: Demonstrated proficiency in Demo2Win, MEDDPICC, value-based selling, ROI analysis, and agentic AI frameworks. Salesforce certifications are a plus.

• Consistently achieves or exceeds influenced ARR targets for Mid-market & Enterprise segment. 
  • Drives measurable improvements in POV win rate, demo quality, and sales cycle velocity. 
  • Demonstrates impact through internal mentorship, enablement contributions, and executive-level customer advocacy. 
  • Recognized internally as a go-to expert for strategic pursuits and enterprise solution storytelling.
